subject: SIG questionnaire and privacy alignment — Acme Health / Redwood
messages:
From: Laura Mills <dpo@acme-health.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire and privacy alignment — Acme Health / Redwood

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this on. We received Redwood's invitation to complete a SIG and have attached our questionnaire (Acme_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx) with a few specific asks around privacy and regulatory alignment. Before we proceed with the full SIG, two quick clarifying items from our side: 

1) DPA and SCCs: Can Redwood execute our Data Processing Addendum and include the EU Standard Contractual Clauses? Do you have a preferred DPA we should expect?

2) HIPAA / BAA feasibility: We are a healthcare customer — is Redwood able to sign a BAA, or alternatively provide a compliant on‑prem or VPC option? If BAA is not feasible, what controls and evidence would you provide to address PHI handling concerns?

3) Evidence and timeline: We will need SOC 2 Type II report, data retention policy, employee access/privilege docs, and evidence of encryption at rest/in transit. Can Redwood provide these as secured links or redacted copies? What is a realistic timeline for the SIG completion and provision of evidence?

For context, procurement and legal are cc'd: contracts@acme-health.com. We hope to close vendor review within 30 days if possible.

Appreciate a short plan and expected timelines so we can align internal reviewers.

Thanks,

Laura Mills
Data Protection Officer
Acme Health
laura.mills@acme-health.com

Attachment: Acme_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx (excel spreadsheet)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Mills <dpo@acme-health.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 12:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and privacy alignment — Acme Health / Redwood

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask and for looping procurement. I'm happy to own the SIG work and coordinate evidence collection. High‑level plan below: 

- SIG completion: We'll populate the SIG template and return a first pass within 7–10 business days. We typically mark responses as "Answered / Evidence Attached / Compensating Controls" where applicable.
- DPA & SCCs: We maintain a standard DPA that includes SCCs. I can attach our current DPA (redwood_dpa_v3.pdf) and flag any negotiation points.
- HIPAA/BAA feasibility: We don't currently offer a standalone BAA as part of our hosted tier, but we do provide a Private deployment option (VPC/managed on‑prem) that many healthcare customers use to meet PHI requirements. I'll run a quick feasibility check and share a short gap analysis (hipaa_prelim_checklist.docx). If you need us to execute a BAA, I will escalate to Legal and confirm feasibility/timeframe.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II can be provided via a secure link once NDA/controls review is in place. We will prepare redacted copies of the following: SOC 2 report, data retention policy, encryption overview, and access control summary.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I'll fill out the SIG template and send back within 7–10 business days.
2) Vivek will share the DPA and coordinate legal conversation.
3) If Acme can share the procurement/contract contact for DocuSign and any mandatory clauses, we'll track those in a mutual action plan.

Is a brief 30‑minute sync early next week helpful? Happy to join with Vivek.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: SIG_Response_Template_v1.xlsx (excel spreadsheet); hipaa_prelim_checklist.docx (word doc)

Laura / Neha — quick note from Legal/Commercial side.

- DPA & SCCs: We have a standard DPA that incorporates the EU SCCs. I attached redwood_dpa_v3.pdf. Our Legal team is open to reasonable redlines but prefers to keep schedules/annexes for data transfers intact.
- BAA: As Neha noted, our hosted offering is not currently accompanied by a BAA. For customers with PHI requirements, we recommend our Private deployment (VPC or on‑prem) or a dedicated instance under Redwood Dedicated. If Acme requires a BAA for hosted data, we need to review contractually with Legal; that typically adds 2–3 weeks.
- Evidence sharing: We will provide SOC 2 Type II via a secure link after a short access request (we can host under a time‑limited Drive folder). If you need the report for procurement, we can share a redacted PDF.

Would love to set a 30‑minute call with your procurement and legal to confirm timelines and signature path. Proposed slots: Tue 10/6 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 10/7 9:00–10:00 PT.

-Vivek

Thanks Neha and Vivek — that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement/legal: 

- Contracts contact: contracts@acme-health.com will coordinate DocuSign. Please send DPA and SOW to that inbox.
- SOC 2 access: redacted PDF is fine for initial review; procurement will request full report under NDA if we move forward.
- HIPAA: Our security review requires either an executed BAA or evidence that PHI will not be stored in your hosted environment (or a private deployment). Please flag which controls apply to PHI handling in your SIG responses.
- Evidence list: procurement is specifically asking for: SOC 2 Type II (redacted ok), data retention policy, encryption at rest documentation, access control matrix, and employee security training logs. We'll aim for a 30‑day vendor review window.

I'll accept Tue 10/6 10:00 PT for a call — adding a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Laura Mills
DPO, Acme Health
